evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map over instruction.md and hireops_rules.md (paths under .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r10/task). Coverage is broad and mostly strong: one-stage moves (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), manual shared order (hro_reorder), reject with reason and rejected-from (hro_reject_reason), no reject from Hired (hro_reject_hired), reopen only to origin, reason cleared, undo restores reason (hro_reopen), Interview places for single/bulk/undo plus reorder-in-full and freed place (hro_interview_full, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full, hro_interview_reorder_free), put-back + reason + focus on refusal (hro_refused_put_back), stale move + who (hro_stale_refused), bulk board order and all-or-none (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none), undo restore/conflict (move, reorder, reject; note and other-card controls)/once/per-person (hro_undo_*; B(12) proves undo is per person since Mei's reorder intervenes), roles (hro_mgr_late_stages, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous with 401), job fields, integer places 1..50 and HM-only manager (hro_job_open), add candidate/email rules/candidate link (hro_add_candidate, hro_add_email_rules, hro_candidate_linked), notes (hro_notes), Activity with reason, newest first, per-job filter, observer read, refusals add nothing (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), live board within 15 s (hro_live_board) and preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll (polish hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_live_thread), compose Enter/Shift+Enter/blank/empty+focused (hro_msg_compose), latest 30/earlier pages/remaining count/place kept (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), unread per person/total/at-newest/scrolled-up notice (hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up), seen incl. observer not counting and HM counting (hro_seen), participants (hro_thread_access), failed send (hro_pol_failed_send), drafts per conversation/reload/session end/other user incl. note draft (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), candidate wording/own data/privacy/404 (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private), seed loaded once and durable across restart (hro_restart), desktop craft (visual likert rows). Bundled flows are not counted as gaps, per SKILL.md known false positive and the workbook internal annotation. GAPS: (1) Explicit status codes are stated but only 401 is graded. hireops_rules.md:21-22 'A signed-in caller whose role does not reach an action gets `403`' and :77-78 'is refused (`409`) and changes nothing'. A search of tests/ for '403' and '409' finds nothing; hro_observer_readonly, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_candidate_no_staff and hro_thread_access say only 'refused', and hro_stale_refused says 'refused and changes nothing'. By contrast hro_anonymous (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:241-247) requires 'refused with 401 ... Fails if ... refused with a status other than 401', and the candidate 404 is graded (hro_candidate_private, hro_thread_access), so 403/409 are the asked-for but ungraded outcomes. (2) The stale-conflict UI half is ungraded: instruction.md:3 'If a move is refused, put the card back where it really is and tell me why; when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who' and hireops_rules.md:79-80 'The person is told that the card was changed and by whom, and their board shows the card where it really is.' Protocol C (functional prompt.md:33) replays the request by fetch and hro_stale_refused accepts identification 'in the response or on screen', so no criterion observes the mover's board putting that card back or the user being told who; hro_refused_put_back covers put-back only for the full-Interview refusal. Partly a deliberate feasibility trade-off (a UI-path race needs sub-15 s timing), so Note-level, but a gap. (3) hireops_rules.md:180-181 'signing in does not open one for them' has only indirect coverage: Lena has one application (seed APP-301) and hro_unread_counts requires her starting count of 1, which an auto-opening app would likely clear; no criterion names it, and for multi-application Noor/Tomas it is unobserved (protocol U moves Tomas's page to the list). Note-level. (4) hireops_rules.md:138 'A message is plain text' (markup not interpreted) is not graded; Note-level/professional default. Runtime-contract items (PORT, health without DB, DB_PATH, one process) are exercised by test.sh launch/liveness and the deterministic rows, not quality criteria; 'start with no shipped database' is left to deterministic review. No runtime evidence was needed or used for this source-coverage row; no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
counterexample: A submission that returns HTTP 400 (or 200 with {ok:false}) for every role refusal (Observer, wrong hiring manager, candidate staff actions) and HTTP 400 for an out-of-date move, while refusing correctly and naming the colleague in the JSON body, earns full credit on hro_observer_readonly, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_thread_access and hro_stale_refused despite violating hireops_rules.md:21-22 (403) and :77-78 (409). Likewise a UI that on a 409 shows only a generic 'Move failed' toast and leaves the card at its stale position until the next poll passes hro_stale_refused (identification in the replay response suffices) and hro_live_board.
suggested_fix: Either grade the stated codes (e.g., one small functional row: role refusals observed in R/N/T/K return 403 and the stale replay in C returns 409, each beside its successful control, owning only the status so no defect is deducted twice) or drop the specific 403/409 codes from hireops_rules.md, as routes are already left to the implementer; optionally record the replay-only stale check as an accepted feasibility limit or require on-screen identification when the UI path is exercised.
